record.kind: OnSimulationStartEffect that installs a PeriodicEffect (+1 speed) on every same-team unit
record.summary: Passive.GEARS has a PassiveEffects entry with one OnSimulationStartEffect. At simulation start, for each Gears holder, it walks the whole board and, for every unit of the holder's team (the holder itself included), adds a new PeriodicEffect to that unit's effectsSet. The period depends on the holder's stars: 3000 / 2000 / 1000 ms for 1 / 2 / 3 stars (KLINK / KLANG / KLINKLANG; fallback 1000). Each firing calls pokemon.addSpeed(1, pokemon, 0, false) on the receiving ally, but only if the holder (the closure variable entity) still has hp > 0. The +1 is the requested amount: addSpeed first applies Big Eater Belt (+25% on a buff, rounded down to an integer, so 1 stays 1 for a single unit) and Twist Band (negative values only, so no effect), then, because the caster is the receiver itself with apBoost 0 and crit false, applies no AP or crit scaling, and clamps speed to 0..300; a receiver with passive MELMETAL gets the value as attack x 0.5 instead of speed. The change is not permanent (permanent false). Each holder installs its own effect objects, so two holders (even of different stars) stack independently on the same ally. Allies that join the board after simulation start do not receive the effect.
triggers: Simulation start (OnSimulationStartEffect) installs the periodic effects
Each PeriodicEffect fires when its timer reaches 0 during PokemonState.update of the receiving unit, then resets to its interval

effects.declaredRaw: +1 speed every 3 / 2 / 1 seconds by holder stars 1 / 2 / 3, to each same-team unit including the holder

effects.declaredRaw: tick does nothing once the holder's hp is 0 or less
effects.resolution: checked at each tick against the holder entity, not the receiver; the effect objects stay on the allies but become no-ops

effects.declaredRaw: applied once to units on the board at simulation start, team match by entity.team
effects.resolution: simulation.board.forEach over cells; units added later (summons, resurrection into new entities) are not covered by this entry

conditions: Only units of the holder's team on the simulation board at start receive the effect.
Holder must have hp > 0 at each tick.
Interval comes from the holder's stars, not the receiver's.
record.resetBehaviour: Timers start at the full interval at simulation start; no reset on cast or damage. Each PeriodicEffect keeps its own timer and count.
